payload.consequence: Four edits to the live issue body were required, gated behind an explicit user approval because the downstream breakdown skill forbids unapproved parent mutation. Slice 4's specification changed before its child issue was published. Caught before any child issue existed and before any implementation, so no dependent work was built on the wrong decision.
payload.expected: A published PRD conforming to the repository's governing authority, since docs/principles/README.md requires every PRD to conform to the principles and accepted ADRs or to amend the higher authority first.
payload.observed: The published PRD stated that the early-review override takes direct flags because its payload is two short human-authored fields. EVIDENCE-AND-DECISIONS.md section 6 requires the override to name why waiting is worse, the evidence bearing that claim, and the bounded review appetite - three fields including evidence references - and CAPABILITY-AND-WORKFLOW-BOUNDARIES.md section 10 requires a consequential human decision to be applied only against an exact presented proposal. The statement reached publication as issue #10.
payload.run_condition: One invocation late in a long multi-skill session, synthesizing an already-ratified scope into a roughly 25,000-character PRD with 61 user stories across seven template sections; the defective statement was one clause in the Implementation Decisions section; it survived publication uncaught by any step in the run and surfaced two user turns later, only when the user requested an authority check during the following skill.
payload.workaround_taken: The PRD body was re-verified against docs/adr, docs/design, and docs/principles after the user asked whether the carried-forward decisions aligned with them, then corrected in place on the published issue before any child issue was created.
